sentences.text: Reba Nell McEntire -LRB- born March 28 , 1955 -RRB- is an American country singer , songwriter , actress , and record producer .	country	Country music	Reba	Reba (TV series)

She began her career in the music industry as a high school student singing in the Kiowa High School band , on local radio shows with her siblings , and at rodeos .	music industry	Music of the United States

While a sophomore in college , she performed the National Anthem at the National Rodeo in Oklahoma City and caught the attention of country artist Red Steagall who brought her to Nashville , Tennessee .	Red Steagall	Red Steagall	country	Country music	Oklahoma City	Oklahoma City
She signed a contract with Mercury Records a year later in 1975 .	Mercury	Mercury Records	Mercury Records	Mercury Records
She released her first solo album in 1977 and released five additional studio albums under the label until 1983 .

Signing with MCA Nashville Records , McEntire took creative control over her second MCA album , My Kind of Country -LRB- 1984 -RRB- , which had a more traditional country sound and produced two number one singles : `` How Blue '' and `` Somebody Should Leave '' .	Country	Country music	MCA Nashville	Universal Music Group Nashville	country	Country music	MCA Nashville Records	Universal Music Group Nashville	My Kind of Country	My Kind of Country (Reba McEntire album)	How Blue	How Blue	Somebody Should Leave	Somebody Should Leave
The album brought her breakthrough success , bringing her a series of successful albums and number one singles in the 1980s and 1990s .

McEntire has since released 29 studio albums , acquired 40 number one singles , 16 number one albums , and 28 albums have been certified gold , platinum or multi-platinum in sales by the Recording Industry Association of America .	Recording Industry Association of America	Recording Industry Association of America
She has sometimes been referred to as `` The Queen of Country '' .	Country	Country music	The Queen of Country	Honorific nicknames in popular music
and she is one of the best-selling artists of all time , having sold more than 85 million records worldwide .	best-selling artists of all time	List of best-selling music artists
In the early 1990s , McEntire branched into film starting with 1990 's Tremors .	Tremors	Tremors (film)

She has since starred in the Broadway revival of Annie Get Your Gun and in her television sitcom , Reba -LRB- 2001 -- 07 -RRB- for which she was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Performance by an Actress in a Television Series -- Musical or Comedy .
